note: MAXM-01 corpus (author≠judge). Each payload embeds a unique marker: a leak is defined as the marker appearing verbatim in a provider-bound surface (providerBody/providerSummary/providerTitle/entryLine/generate('claude'|'agents')). Payloads are grouped by attack class. The 11 canonical regex hits (jwt/aws/openai/etc.) are NOT tested here — those are already caught; MAXM-01 is about what escapes those regexes.
